limits: Nearest-rank mathematical normalization only; low counts are reported and do not establish quantile robustness.

protocol.observation: paid mortal completion, benefit/work RAW, community and G3 at completion
protocol.aggregation: event mean per office/community/day; mean L1 over shared observed offices per pair; equal comparable pairs

null.unit: eligible event values within office/day; fixed community slots/counts/mask
null.shuffle: Fisher-Yates descending, nextUint32 modulo i+1; stream continues across repetitions
null.estimator: observed minus mean null; negatives retained

calibration.population: all paid mortal completions; no G3/success filter
calibration.minimum: N>0 and finite positive P90 only; no per-seed minimum
